notes: «وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدٌ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» : the asker is the link, then the Imam he asks (rule 5, owner ruling 2)
The Imam's honorific is left out; the surface is written as the report names him
«وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدٌ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» : the asker is the link, then the Imam he asks (rule 5, owner ruling 2)
The Imam's honorific is left out; the surface is written as the report names him
«سأل مُحَمَّدٌ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ»: the asker is a link and the Imam, the one asked who answers, is the last link, kind imam_in_text (rule 5, ruling 2); not completed (ruling 3).
